Historically, databases have invested significant efforts to reduce                         exploit the distributed nature of database engines, particularly in the
I/O overheads. Initially, memory was very limited in capacity and                           cloud, to take advantage of non-local memory. In such distributed
disks were slow. Over time the bottleneck shifted as faster storage                         settings, the coupling of storage, compute, and memory capacity is
became available (SSDs, Non-Volatile Memory (NVM)), memories                                problematic both cost-wise and performance-wise: the inability to in-
became larger, and multicore emerged. Yet, the I/O overhead remains                         dependently provision each of those elements leads to inefficiencies
a major factor in the overall performance. To minimize it, databases                        due to over-provisioning. For instance, allocating large amounts of
have relied on keeping more and more data in memory, a trend that                           memory for tasks that are not compute-heavy leaves CPU unused, as
cannot continue for two main reasons: databases induce considerable                         other applications might not be able to run on the remaining memory.
data movement, which is known to be highly inefficient in modern                            Conversely, allocating many virtual CPUs to a task may result in the
                                                                                            memory being underutilized for lack of compute capacity for other

   To deploy operators that can process data on the disaggregated
memory, the FPGA is divided into multiple isolated virtual dynamic                   Figure 2: High level view of Farview’s architecture
regions that operate concurrently. These dynamic regions can be
obtained by different clients and can process different query requests.
Each dynamic region serves an access request to the disaggregated
memory and can implement a separate operator pipeline that can                be seen as a specialized stream processor acting on the data as it
execute a set of different queries. These regions are dynamically             moves from the memory stack to the network stack. It also controls
reconfigurable: the logic deployed in them can be swapped at runtime          how data is retrieved from the memory stack. The operator stack is
without having to reconfigure the whole FPGA. This swap takes on              reconfigurable, and its operator logic can be changed at any point
the order of milliseconds, depending on the size of the regions [46].         without affecting the operation of the rest of the system.
